title: DEO: Training-Free Direct Embedding Optimization for Negation-Aware Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2603.09185v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) have enabled diverse retrieval methods. However, existing retrieval methods often fail to accurately retrieve results for negation and exclusion queries. To address this limitation, prior approaches rely on embedding adaptation or fine-tuning, which introduce additional computational cost and deployment complexity. We propose Direct Embedding Optimization (DEO), a training-free method for negation-aware text and multimodal retrieval. DEO decomposes queries into positive and negative components and optimizes the query embedding with a contrastive objective. Without additional training data or model updates, DEO outperforms baselines on NegConstraint, with gains of +0.0738 nDCG@10 and +0.1028 MAP@100, while improving Recall@5 by +6\% over OpenAI CLIP in multimodal retrieval. translated_title: DEO：面向否定感知检索的无训练直接嵌入优化
translated_abstract: 近年来，大型语言模型（LLM）和检索增强生成（RAG）的进展催生了多样化的检索方法。然而，现有的检索方法在处理否定和排除类查询时往往无法准确检索结果。为解决这一局限，以往的方法依赖嵌入适配或微调，这带来了额外的计算成本和部署复杂性。我们提出了直接嵌入优化（DEO），这是一种无需训练的否定感知文本和多模态检索方法。DEO将查询分解为正向和负向分量，并通过对比目标对查询嵌入进行优化。在无需额外训练数据或模型更新的情况下，DEO在NegConstraint基准上超越了基线方法，取得了+0.0738的nDCG@10和+0.1028的MAP@100提升，同时在多模态检索中将Recall@5相比OpenAI CLIP提高了+6%。这些结果证明了DEO在否定与排除感知检索方面的实用性。
tldr: 提出无需训练的直接嵌入优化方法DEO，通过将查询分解为正负分量并以对比目标优化查询嵌入，在无需额外训练数据或模型更新的情况下显著提升否定与排除类查询的文本和多模态检索性能。
en_tdlr: DEO is a training-free direct embedding optimization method that decomposes queries into positive and negative components and optimizes query embeddings with a contrastive objective, significantly improving negation- and exclusion-aware text and multimodal retrieval without additional training data or model updates.
